title: UniFlow-Chatbot
tagline: AI-powered Uniswap V4 portfolio optimization chatbot with real-time LP discovery
description:
This project leverages OpenClaw, an AI chatbot that has seen a significant popularity, integrated with Privy's Agentic Wallet and Uniswap SDK to guarantee both frictionless UX, industry standard security, and high quality on-chain data retrieval. 

The chatbot itself is hosted on a VPS with recommended security setup based on OpenClaw's documentation and custom-made skills (https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skills), ensuring user's peace of mind.

Enhanced further with an integration to a dedicated backend service, we are able to shape this chatbot's personality into an agentic Uniswap portfolio manager that we proudly call UniFlow.
how_its_made:
This project leverages OpenClaw (https://openclaw.ai/) technology deployed on a VPS with the recommended security setup in order to build a highly secure vanilla chatbot that can be shaped into a personality you want, and can evolve over time as you interact more with it. 

Connected to a backend (written in express.js + Typescript) powered by Privy's Agentic Wallet and Uniswap SDK, we shape this bot into UniFlow, an agentic Uniswap V4 portfolio optimization chatbot that can access real-time on-chain data.

We also provide a landing page written in Next.js and Typescript to showcase the exciting capabilities UniFlow can offer to users.
